# Skrongle

> A learning app driven by JSON courses: a `course.json` manifest plus one JSON file per lesson. Every mode (Sprint, Study, Play, Guide, AI tutoring) reads the same files.

To write a course: read the course format (it is complete and self-contained), write `course.json` first, then one lesson file at a time, and reply with JSON only. Check files against the JSON Schema. In the app, add them on the course page (`/courses/<id>`); every save validates the whole course and the error names the file and field.

## Course authoring

- [Course format]({base}/docs/course-format.md): every field and rule of `course.json` and lesson files, with a minimal valid course. The app's own course generator uses this exact text.
- [Course JSON Schema]({base}/docs/course.schema.json): the same rules as JSON Schema (manifest and lesson definitions).
- [How a course is built]({base}/docs/course-structure.md): a worked example from the Spanish course and which field switches on which feature.

## Optional

- [Features]({base}/docs/features.md): what each part of the app does and which lesson fields it reads.
- [The MCP server]({base}/docs/api.md): `POST /mcp` with a token from the profile, the course tools (read the format, list, read, validate, create, change files), scopes and errors.
- [Progress across modes]({base}/docs/progress.md): the pass rule, and the API and brief for an AI agent that teaches the learner.
- [Building and generating courses]({base}/docs/making-courses.md): the editor, the upload API, AI generation, fixing validation errors.
- [Getting started]({base}/docs/getting-started.md): the modes and how "passed" works.
- [Set up Skrongle on a new Raspberry Pi]({base}/docs/setup-home-wifi.md): the step-by-step guide to a running Skrongle on a home Wi-Fi.
- [Away from home with Tailscale]({base}/docs/setup-tailscale.md): reach a self-hosted Skrongle from anywhere over a private link.
